title: Hydration (urine specific gravity)
text: Test the first urine of the day with a fresh dip strip, reading the colour at exactly the maker's time. Darker colour means more concentrated urine.

Above 1.020 scores watch (ACSM position stand on exercise and fluid replacement, 2007): drink to the mission fluid plan and re-check. Persistent dark urine with little output needs the crew medical officer.

citations.source: ACSM position stand on exercise and fluid replacement (2007).
